title: Host: touch input path for the next image: fix e1s_touch.c physical-address GPIO access (NAT-066 abort), add staged bring-up (e1stouch_steps), add a /dev/hakios-touch devfs node for the prebuilt libhakios reader, extend KRN-044 rebuild.py to several objects; host tests on a fake register file; image build, analyser and decision; no phone action
acceptance: every GPIO access in e1s_touch.c uses the ml_io_map'ed base; a fake-register host test of the extracted functions shows only offsets inside the mapped pages
staged boot-arg: step 1 writes nothing; step 2 changes only gpp9[0..3] function/pull and reads the STM device id; step 3 starts the event loop
kernel exposes /dev/hakios-touch with the same record layout; libhakios open path confirmed from its strings
image built on NAT-119's, decision draft with risks (pin direction change on the touch SPI bus, rails unknown)
